The helper only supports csv/tsv/xlsx, so I'll parse the JSON directly.

```python
import json
with open('./kernel-e4514a0b-047f-4557-9bf9-eb42095a3277.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
print(type(data))
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2)[:3000])
```
